deviation2.what: CAMP01_ARTIFACT_DIR and CAMP01_RUN_ID were exported ONLY for each wave's jest leg (commandSequence[0]); every Playwright leg, and camp-01g's readiness-stable leg, ran with NO CAMP01_* variable set at all
deviation2.why: scripts/qc/camp01-runner-isolation.mjs createCamp01RunnerIsolation() treats CAMP01_RUN_ID / CAMP01_ARTIFACT_DIR / CAMP01_INVOCATION_ID / CAMP01_EXECUTION_ID as an all-or-nothing tuple: `if (present.length !== IDENTITY_KEYS.length) fail('partial CAMP context')`. scripts/playwright/run-playwright.mjs calls it unconditionally at startup, so leaking a 2-of-4 CAMP context into a Playwright leg would have hard-failed the runner before any test ran.
deviation2.whyTheFullTupleWasNotSynthesized: the full 4-key tuple is writer-issued and this lane declined to forge it. createCamp01RunnerIsolation additionally requires (a) the artifact directory basename to be exactly `.stage-<runId>`, (b) its parent, relative to the repo root, to match the row's runRootTemplate with a 40-hex sha in the <sha> slot, and (c) the (invocationId, executionId) pair to equal issuedCommandIdentity(row, index, runId) for EXACTLY ONE row/index across all of WAVE_CONTRACTS. Conditions (a) and (b) are directly contradicted by this lane's chartered artifact-dir location; and manufacturing (c) outside the receipt writer would fabricate controller provenance, which is precisely the thing these receipt runs exist to NOT do. The sibling camp01bc lane made the same call.
deviation2.consequenceForThisTriple: MATERIALLY LARGER than for camp-01a/b/c/d. Because CAMP01_INVOCATION_ID could not be set: (1) camp-01e's in-spec capture block `if (process.env.CAMP01_INVOCATION_ID === 'camp-01e-picker-browser')` (e2e/campaign-customizer-handoff.spec.ts:397) never fired, so desktop.png and mobile-390x844.png were not captured; (2) camp-01f's block at line 519 never fired, so the camp01-campaign-persistence-authority/v1 attachment was never made; (3) camp-01g's block at line 622 never fired, so the camp01-mech-bay-authority/v1 attachment was never made. Independently, scripts/qc/camp01-playwright-normalizer.mjs prepareCamp01PlaywrightCollection() returns inactive() whenever isolation is inactive (`if (!isolation?.active) return inactive();`), so the gReports normalizer that would write reports/campaign-persistence-authority.json and reports/mech-bay-authority.json was never armed either.
